quarterly_data.signal: Guideline status stated with the EU approval of Datroway for 1st-line metastatic triple-negative breast cancer: based on TROPION-Breast02, Datroway has been included in the ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines as a Category IA 1st-line treatment option for patients with metastatic TNBC who are not candidates for immunotherapy, and it is the preferred option for patients who relapsed within six months of completing adjuvant therapy; it also received a score of 4 out of 5 on the ESMO Magnitude of Clinical Benefit Scale (ESMO-MCBS).
quarterly_data.figure: ESMO guideline Category IA; ESMO-MCBS score 4 out of 5
